capture_rule.fail_closed: Non-2xx, identity mismatch, parse ambiguity or indirect copy is CANNOT_CHECK.
capture_rule.method: Exactly one HTTP GET sequence per frozen official GitHub route, identifying User-Agent, redirects followed, 30-second timeout.
capture_rule.raw_retention: Temporary bytes deleted after bounded extraction; no raw issue, licence or schema payload is retained in the packet.
capture_rule.record: Requested/final URL, UTC time, HTTP status, content type, ETag, Last-Modified, byte length and SHA-256.

frozen_gates.pass_rule: The official issue record explicitly names delegator, delegate, exact seven-target R7 scope, powers to complete and ratify the algebra, effective time and acceptance. Repository ownership, issue authorship, assignment, prose requests or agent work are insufficient.

An exact completed seven-profile V8 algebra exists at the frozen commit and the applicable rights holder grants storage, machine processing, derived semantic adjudication, audit quotation and release rights for those exact bytes. A licence over an empty schema/template is only a component and cannot pass.
The captured artifact is an instance, not a JSON Schema; it contains exactly seven complete target profiles plus authority, rights, ratification signatures and independent review values.

frozen_routes.retention: HTTP provenance, exact response digest, bounded issue number/state/timestamps/author-login and delegation-field booleans; no comments, labels/outcomes or third-party copies.

frozen_routes.expected_identity: Repository root LICENSE at exact commit 8d47c546591a3c96dc5cf202f7e227d13251221c
frozen_routes.retention: HTTP provenance, exact digest, bounded licence identity/grant/copyright fields; no inference of scientific authority.

frozen_routes.expected_identity: Exact committed V8 prospective owner-algebra schema
frozen_routes.retention: HTTP provenance, exact digest, JSON structural counts, schema-versus-instance classification and ratification-value presence only.

non_substitution_rules: Repository author/login/owner identity is not R7 vocabulary ownership.
Issue authorship or task assignment is not formal delegation unless every frozen delegation field is explicit.
An open-source licence grants copyright permissions, not scientific owner, host, reviewer or custody authority.
A schema describing required fields is not a completed algebra instance.
Same-workspace or AI evidence is not external custody or independent review.
prohibitions: No case text or outcome access.
No self-issued or repository-derived authority promotion.
No fabricated delegation, rights, signature, review, custody, gold or certified map.
No pytest, repository CI, manuscript, shared ledger, Git history or other-lane edit.
scientific_question: Do exact official public repository records explicitly delegate the seven-target R7 vocabulary authority, or bind applicable rights over a completed R7 owner algebra, rather than merely evidence repository authorship or a licence over an incomplete schema?
